description: ASHFALL: THE VERDICT — machine-readable master data. Companion to docs/expansions/expansion_08_the_verdict_plan.md. The machine that keeps the count after the people stopped.

currencies.label: Enrolled Evidence
currencies.note: A reading the machine keeps only because a human read it. Fragile: it is a record, not a resource.

readout_steps.label: Fuse world schedule advances 12 minutes
readout_steps.readout: A clock being serviced, not an attack.

readout_steps.label: Drone-hive draw -0.5 degrees
readout_steps.readout: The wing standing down, the way a wing stands down.

readout_steps.label: The carrier tone on a dead band

endings.label: The Sector Recounts
endings.trigger: enrolled_evidence >= threshold AND presented count honored
endings.vignette: The count is read aloud at the Grain Exchange weighbridge by a trader who does not look up from the scale. It takes three minutes. The last line is the count, presented, in the machine's hand, followed by the two words the sector will argue about forever: accepted as read.

endings.label: The Count Is Held
endings.trigger: enrolled_evidence < threshold AND count not presented
endings.vignette: Nobody presents the count. The carrier tone continues on the dead band. The radio screen reads, forever after, CENSUS WINDOW: OPEN. The last image is the tone: one second on, one second off, on a band nobody is listening to, keeping a count nobody asked it to keep, keeping it anyway.

endings.label: The Offer Is a Lease
endings.vignette: The count converts into a lease: quarterly maintenance, a reading per season, a census every 1,827 days, enforceable by the machine's own registers. The last image: a quarterly invoice, printed on a machine that stopped printing anything else in Year One, delivered to a door that opens, because the door is counted.

world_history_ladder.title: The First Geophone Pit
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The array reads the ground the way the papers said it never did: even, patient, and uninterested in everything above it but the count.

world_history_ladder.title: The Linen Codes
world_history_ladder.body_summary: Twenty-nine shift charters frame the readout cabinets. The machine kept the codes after the staff stopped keeping the shifts.

world_history_ladder.title: The Standard for the Continuance of Service
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The charter's full text. The sentence that does the work: nothing in this Standard shall be construed to require the presentation to be read.

world_history_ladder.title: Hold Pending Count
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The UXO field register reads held, not live. The fields were never awake. They were held Pending Count since a war the count never ended.

world_history_ladder.title: The Reckoning Call
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The census carrier is a pure data tone on a derelict band. The words are thirty years old, the voice is dead, and the schedule is still walking.

world_history_ladder.title: The Count
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The count is presented. It names the shelter's persons, by name. A machine does not reason. It counts. This is the count.

world_history_ladder.title: The Second Geophone Pit
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The second array is not a copy of the first. Its stations fire into the ridge and listen for the answer, a deeper register built to compare one machine's patience with another's.

world_history_ladder.title: The Cable Run East
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The cable does not terminate at a weapon. It runs from the sounding stations to a relay mast, where the line is converted into a schedule the counting house can carry. The machines were built to serve the interval between a reading and the order that follows it.

world_history_ladder.title: The Counting House Before the Count
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The radar annex predates the census language. Its target grid is a list of what might cross the horizon, and the first count began as a promise that no movement would go unrecorded. The later register only changed the object being counted.

world_history_ladder.title: The First Halt
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The barograph shows a clean break in the transmission record: eleven minutes with no pressure, no wind, and no machine status. Then the carrier returns under a new station prefix, and the log marks the restart as routine. No one signed the line.

world_history_ladder.title: The Last Hand
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The final operator left a grease mark on the bus valve and a correction to the horizon grid. The mark is human, the correction is careful, and the duty roster says the station was already empty. The machine kept the hand as an unresolved maintenance event.

world_history_ladder.title: The Open Count
world_history_ladder.body_summary: The checkpoint ledger closes every convoy except the one that carried the count onward. Forty-two entries remain without a destination, so the register keeps the window open rather than call them absent. A count that cannot close becomes a duty passed from office to office.
